steps_completed.details: Audited TreatmentPlanModule, TreatmentPlanStagesListSection, TreatmentPlanAddServiceModal, useTreatmentPlanLogic, and StageItemRow. Identified modal-barrier defect: adding services previously required opening a modal on every action.

steps_completed.name: Seamless integration into TreatmentPlanStagesListSection & TreatmentPlanModule
steps_completed.details: Added 1-click service addition directly from catalog to active stage without modal dialogs. Added layout switcher (Split-Catalog / Full Cards) to TreatmentPlanSpecialtyFilterBar. Preserved 100% backward compatibility with existing tests and flows.

steps_completed.name: Unit test suite & quality gates
steps_completed.details: Created apps/web/src/components/treatment-plans/__tests__/treatmentPlanSplitCatalogMode.test.tsx. Ran vitest across all 4 suites: 20 passing tests, 0 failing. Verified check-encoding.mjs (14634 files clean) and check-css-tokens.mjs (100% valid tokens).

defects_identified.impact: Doctors had to open, search, select, confirm, and close TreatmentPlanAddServiceModal for every single procedure.
defects_identified.remediation: Implemented StomX parity: Split-Catalog mode with left accordion catalog and 1-click instant append into active stage.

defects_identified.defect: Missing tooth selector in catalog view
defects_identified.impact: Doctors had to navigate into tooth configuration sub-dialogs.
defects_identified.remediation: Implemented SplitCatalogToothQuickBar with 1-click FDI chip selection (11-48 and general).

defects_identified.defect: Lack of quantity stepper in stages list table
defects_identified.impact: Editing procedure quantity required deep row clicking.
defects_identified.remediation: Implemented compact [- 1 +] steppers in StageServicesTableRow with instant kopeck-accurate sum recalculations.
